pr_title: Make it visible under light theme

issue_context.title: support light theme
issue_context.body:
Currently, the style of `filename` is bold white: 

https://github.com/charliermarsh/ruff/blob/6733aad216295a9f7850d16291f7831cc31ec7fa/src/message.rs#LL59C71-L59C71

This means, if users are using a light theme, it's almost invisible.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12974685/203072105-8253bef8-e9e0-4bd6-8f01-02feeb80518f.png)

I wonder if this can be another color.

review_comments: Does the cyan work out ok for light themes? Should we have an entirely separate "theme"?

Yes. Cyan works well.

For now, I think the default color (white on the dark theme and black on the light theme) looks good. Red and cyan should work for most of the themes.
